summary: Search pilot-only screen variants (bootstrap-F with k in 30/40/60, thresholds 0.5/0.4, plus RF-importance bootstrap screen) by nested-CV AUC; pick best for locking.
reasoning: The first design (k=25, thresh 0.5) is seed-stable but keeps only 11 weak-marginal features and its repeated nested CV lands at 0.694, below the 0.70 floor. All knobs are chosen on pilot data alone. I compare: bootstrap-F screens with larger k per resample and majority threshold 0.5/0.4 (more true features survive the vote; RF tolerates redundancy), and a multivariate screen where each bootstrap resample is scored by RF Gini importances (captures interaction signal that F misses). Each variant is scored by the same honest protocol: screen refit inside every outer fold, inner 3-fold grid over RF max_features/min_samples_leaf. Heldout remains untouched. Expectation: at least one variant's nested-CV AUC reaches >= 0.70; I select the variant with the best AUC (ties: fewer features) for the locked estimate run.
